headline: Creative bodies from around the world have launched an ethical charter on AI, saying they acted because government policy has left a gap.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered to 4: headline only, the Bookseller article was behind a sign-in wall and no other outlet carries the story, so the charter's content is unverified.
importance_line: Writers, artists and other creators are the likely audience, then publishers and AI developers, but the signatories, the charter's terms and whether any AI company has agreed to it are not known from the headline.
summary: The Bookseller reports that global creative bodies have launched an ethical AI charter, acting, in the words of its headline, "in the vacuum of government policy".
notes: Headline only: the Bookseller page returned a sign-in wall and six Google News searches found no other outlet with the story. Which bodies signed and what the charter says are unknown. Score lowered from 5 to 4 as unverified.
